title: Rearrange Spaces Between Words
description: Rearrange spaces in a string to be distributed equally between words, with leftover spaces at the end.
pseudocode:
1. words = text.split().filter(Boolean)
2. spaceCount = (text.match(/ /g) || []).length
3. gaps = words.length > 1 ? words.length - 1 : 1
4. perGap = words.length > 1 ? Math.floor(spaceCount / gaps) : 0
5. extra = words.length > 1 ? spaceCount % gaps : spaceCount
6. result = words.join(' '.repeat(perGap)) + ' '.repeat(extra)

steps.note: Split the input string into an array of individual words.
Count total spaces in original string ' hello   world ' (5 spaces).
Determine the number of gaps between words.
Calculate spaces per gap: 5 spaces / 1 gap = 5.
